alpaca.name: alpaca
alpaca.notes: US-listed stocks/ETFs and US equity options only; day orders; extended-hours orders are not supported by the ETI client. Options need an Alpaca account with options trading approved.

binance.name: binance
binance.notes: Spot only (no margin, futures or options). The symbol must be listed on Binance spot.

oanda.name: oanda
oanda.notes: Spot FX and metals, plus index/commodity CFDs. Paper = OANDA practice account. Instruments offered depend on your OANDA entity and jurisdiction (CFDs are not available to US accounts); ETI checks your account's instrument list.

holidays_file._comment: Exchange holiday calendars with provenance. verification: official = published by the exchange/operator; secondary = third-party list cross-checked against statutory rules; derived = computed from the country's public-holiday rules and Easter (verify with the exchange). Dates are local exchange dates (YYYY-MM-DD). early_closes map a date to the local closing time. Calendars NOT listed here (e.g. NGX, GSE, EGX, NSE Kenya, SSE, NSE India, KRX) are intentionally absent: no verifiable source was available, and Islamic holidays there are announced at short notice.

asx.name: Australian Securities Exchange (cash market)
asx.notes: Early close = end of normal trading (Sydney time). Per ASX, ANZAC Day 2027 (Mon 26 April) is a normal trading day.

euronext.name: Euronext cash markets (Amsterdam, Brussels, Dublin, Lisbon, Paris; common closures only)
euronext.notes: Only closures common to every Euronext market are listed. Venue-specific closures (Oslo, Dublin, Athens, and Milan on 24/31 Dec) and the half-day closes on 24 and 31 December are NOT modelled (closing times are published per market, not on the summary page).

hkex.name: Hong Kong Exchange
hkex.source: https://www.calendarlabs.com/hkex-market-holidays-2026/ (holiday names in that list are unreliable; weekday dates were kept). Half-day sessions (Christmas Eve, New Year's Eve, Lunar New Year's Eve) are NOT modelled.

jse.name: Johannesburg Stock Exchange
jse.source: https://www.calendarlabs.com/jse-market-holidays-2026/ plus South Africa's Public Holidays Act rule that a holiday falling on a Sunday moves to Monday (the list omitted Women's Day, 2026-08-10). The official JSE market notice could not be retrieved (robots.txt disallowed).

jse_2027.name: Johannesburg Stock Exchange (2027, derived)
jse_2027.source: Derived from South Africa's public-holiday rules and Easter 2027 (28 March; Good Friday 26 March agrees with NYSE's official calendar). The aggregator's 2027 JSE list was rejected: it puts Good Friday on 3 April 2027 and Family Day on 6 April, which is wrong. Verify against the JSE market notice.

lse.name: London Stock Exchange
lse.source: https://www.financecalendar.com/lse-holidays/ (cites the LSE business-days page, the authoritative reference); 2026 dates are the England & Wales bank holidays

tse.name: Tokyo Stock Exchange (JPX)
tse.notes: JPX notes holidays can change if Japan's national holidays change.

xetra.name: Xetra (Deutsche Boerse, Frankfurt)
xetra.notes: On German/Hessian public holidays that are trading days (e.g. Ascension 2026-05-14), trading in shares ends at 20:00 CET; Dec 30 2026 may have deviating hours (circular pending).
